<br>

## Categorical var (totals)

```{r bar_cat}

bar_cat <- function(outcome, data, statistics = c("count"), # Can be "perc" 
                    title = NULL, horiz = F, fill = "pink") {

  dat <- calc_stats(
    data       = data,
    outcomes   = outcome,
    statistics = statistics
  ) 
  
  if(statistics == "perc"){dat$estimate <- dat$estimate * 100}

  x_lab <- dat$o_lab %>% unique()

  plt <- bar(
    dat       = dat,
    x         = o_cat,
    y         = estimate,
    x_lab     = x_lab,
    y_lab     = ifelse(statistics %in% "perc", "%", "Count"),
    title     = title, 
    fill = fill,
    horiz = horiz
  )

  plt

}

bar_cat(data = survey, outcome = "Smoke", statistics = "perc", title = "Smoking habit among the students", fill = "grey4")
bar_cat(data = survey, outcome = "Smoke", statistics = "count", title = "Smoking habit among the students", horiz = T)

```

<br>

# Numeric vars (totals)

```{r}

bar_num <- function(outcomes, data, statistics = c("median"), # can be "mean"
                    title = NULL, horiz = F, fill = "pink", 
                    x_lab = NULL) {

  stopifnot(length(statistics) == 1)
  
  dat <- calc_stats(
    data       = data,
    outcomes   = outcomes,
    statistics = statistics
  ) 

  plt <- bar(
    dat       = dat,
    x         = o_lab,
    y         = estimate,
    x_lab     = x_lab,
    y_lab     = ifelse(statistics %in% "mean", "Mean", "Median"),
    title     = title, 
    fill = fill,
    horiz = horiz
  )

  plt

}

bar_num(data = survey, outcomes = c("Pulse", "Height", "Age"), title = "All numeric vars", 
        x_lab = "These are different variables, see?")

bar_num(data = survey, outcomes = c("Pulse", "Height", "Age"), title = "All numeric vars", 
        x_lab = "These are different variables, see?", 
        statistics = "mean")
```

<br>

```{r, error=T}
bar_num(data = survey, outcomes = c("Pulse", "Height", "Age"), title = "All numeric vars", 
        x_lab = "These are different variables, see?", 
        statistics = c("mean", "median"))
```

## Numeric var (crossbreak)

```{r}

bar_num_by <- 
  function(
      outcome, 
      predictor,
      data, 
      statistics = c("median"), # can be "mean"
      title = NULL, 
      horiz = F, 
      fill = "pink",
      show_total = T
      ) {

  stopifnot(length(statistics) == 1)
  
  dat <- calc_stats(
    data       = data,
    outcome    = outcome,
    predictors = predictor,
    statistics = statistics
  ) 
  
  if(show_total==F){dat <- dat %>% filter(p_cat1 != "Total")}
  x_lab <- dat$p_lab1 %>% grep("Total", ., value = T, invert = T) %>% unique()
  
  plt <- bar(
    dat       = dat,
    x         = p_cat1,
    y         = estimate,
    x_lab     = x_lab,
    y_lab     = ifelse(statistics %in% "mean", "Mean", "Median"),
    title     = title, 
    fill = fill,
    horiz = horiz
  )

  plt

  }

bar_num_by(data = survey, outcome = c("Pulse"), predictor = "Smoke",
           title = "All numeric vars", 
           statistics = c("mean"), fill = "mint2"
           )

bar_num_by(data = survey, outcome = c("Pulse"), predictor = "Exer",
           title = "All numeric vars", 
           statistics = c("mean"), fill = "mint2",
           horiz = T, show_total = F) 

```

## Categorical var (crossbreak - stack)

```{r}

bar_cat_by <- function(outcome, predictor, data, statistics = c("perc"), # Can be "count" 
                    title = NULL, horiz = F, fill_family = NULL, show_total = T) {

  stopifnot(length(statistics) == 1)

  dat <- calc_stats(
    data       = data,
    outcomes   = outcome,
    predictors = predictor,
    statistics = statistics
  ) 
  
  if(show_total==F){dat <- dat %>% filter(p_cat1 != "Total")}
  if(statistics == "perc"){dat$estimate <- dat$estimate * 100}
  x_lab <- dat$p_lab1 %>% grep("Total", ., value = T, invert = T) %>% unique()
  
  bar_stacked(dat = dat, 
              x = p_cat1, 
              y = estimate,
              fill = o_cat,
              fill_family = fill_family,
              x_lab = x_lab,
              y_lab = ifelse(statistics %in% "perc", "%", "Count"),
              title = title,
              horiz = horiz
  )
}

bar_cat_by(data = survey, predictor = "Sex", outcome = "Smoke")
bar_cat_by(data = survey, predictor = "Sex", outcome = "Clap", 
          horiz = T, fill_family = "blue", show_total = F
          )


```

  bar_clustered(dat = dat, 
              x = p_cat1,

bar_cat_by2(data = survey, predictor = "Sex", outcome = "Smoke")

```{r}

bar_by <- function(
    data, 
    outcome, 
    predictor = NULL, 
    cluster = F,
    statistics = c("perc"), # Can be "count"
    title = NULL, 
    horiz = F, 
    fill_family = NULL, 
    show_total = T
    ) {
  
  stopifnot(length(statistics) == 1)
  
  if(statistics %in% c("mean", "median")){
    chart_type = "num"} else {chart_type = "cat"}
  
    dat <- 
      calc_stats(
        data       = data,
        outcomes   = outcome,
        predictors = predictor,
        statistics = statistics
        ) 
  
  if(chart_type == "num" & is.null(predictor)){
    
    chart_func <- bar
    x_arg <- sym("o_lab")

  } else if (chart_type == "cat" & is.null(predictor)){
    
    chart_func <- bar
    x_arg <- sym("o_cat")
    x_lab_arg <- sym("o_lab")
  
  } else if (chart_type == "num" & !is.null(predictor)){
    
    chart_func <- bar
  
  } else if (chart_type == "cat" & !is.null(predictor) & cluster == F){
    
    chart_func <- bar_stacked
  
  } else {chart_func <- bar_clustered}
    
  if(!is.null(predictor)){
    x_arg <- sym("p_cat1")
    x_lab_arg <- dat$p_lab1 %>% grep("Total", ., value = T, invert = T) %>% unique()
  }  
  
  if(show_total==F & !is.null(predictor)){dat <- dat %>% filter(p_cat1 != "Total")}
  if(statistics == "perc"){dat$estimate <- dat$estimate * 100}

  chart_func(dat = dat, 
              x = x_arg, 
              y = estimate,
              fill = o_cat,
              fill_family = fill_family,
              x_lab = x_lab,
              y_lab = ifelse(statistics %in% "perc", "%", "Count"),
              title = title,
              horiz = horiz
  )
}

```
